title.narrative: Advancing Ethical Standards and Capacity Development in AI for Central Asia

description.narrative: Acknowledging Kazakhstan's emerging prominence in the digital innovation landscape, the UNESCO Almaty Regional Office aims to engage closely with Kazakhstan and its Central Asian neighbors to champion the principles and values outlined in the Recommendation on the Ethics of AI. The initiative will bolster UNESCO's efforts to enhance capacity building and policy advisory roles by forming strategic alliances with relevant stakeholders across the region. Furthermore, UNESCO is committed to utilizing its repository of knowledge instruments to meticulously assess ethical challenges and support member states in the formulation and implementation of comprehensive AI policies, ensuring a harmonized approach towards ethical AI development in Central Asia.
